title: The Musician Bottle and the Cap Code
lessons: The player discovers a musician-branded PRIME bottle and realizes the collaboration is part of the product launch.
The player has bought a Collector Series bottle and learns that the cap code was part of a completed collectible promotion.

text: Festival merch tent. Among the shirts, a PRIME bottle with the headliner's face on it. It's part of the launch, not just a sticker.

entry-first-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Limited artist bottle. Try to act surprised.

entry-first-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: I clocked the artist before I clocked the flavor.

entry-first-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Then it did exactly what I paid for.

entry-first-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: Does the artist change anything about what's actually inside?

entry-first-5.speaker: PRIME
text: The art on the outside changes. Electrolytes don't negotiate.

choice-first.speaker: PRIME
text: You want it. Just say it.

choices.text: I want it because it feels collectible.
Does the artist actually make the drink any better?
I don't buy drinks because a celebrity is on the label.

first-1.speaker: PRIME
text: There it is. You want the bottle.

first-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I never said I was proud of it.

first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: No. The face changes why you looked. It doesn't touch the chemistry. I'd tell you if it did, I'd never shut up about it.

first-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Then judge the regular bottle. The collab was never mandatory. It was just louder.
You bought a Collector Series bottle a while back. Under the cap there's a code, and when you type it in, the page says the promotion has ended.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: There's a code under this cap?

entry-return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Was. Collector Series turned every bottle into a game piece.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Past tense?

entry-return-4.speaker: PRIME
text: The drop ran, then it closed. While it was live, codes unlocked digital trophies and merch, and the full set fed into a bigger prize. You missed it. Sorry. Kind of.

choice-return.speaker: PRIME
text: Don't look at me like that. You'd have played.

choices.text: That's ridiculous enough that I would have played.
So the game existed to keep people buying bottles.
I don't want hydration turned into a loot hunt.

return-1.speaker: PRIME
text: I know you would have. I'd have run it just for you. When I do a promo, I do the whole promo.

return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Yes. Collecting only works if the next bottle matters more than the last one. That's the design. I'm not hiding it under the cap.

return-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Then drink it and skip the game. That was always allowed. Fewer people picked it than you'd think.
